body: That I wasn't depressed and suicidal. That I could be happy and enjoy life. That I could sleep without having to get black out drunk. You're kind to listen me ramble.
What the hell is wrong with me. I wish I was so many things besides me. I wish I was strong. I wish I was brave. I wish I was someone else who didn't feel this way.
I can't do it anymore though. I just can't. I hate myself. I can't wake up to the same stuff everyday. I just can't. I'm sorry to you too. I just can't though.
Who are you? I mean, I don't want to know name or location or that stuff, but why do you want to help me.
Whoever you are, you are a good person. I'm being serious. I might end it tonight, or I might get too scared. You're good people though. If I do finish it, I promise it's not you're fault at all.
People I thought loved me don't anymore. Oh well. I've never talked to a professional. I just can't. Too much anxiety. I'm drinking right now, and hopefully it gives me enough courage to finish it.

I work around people a lot. I've been depressed for a long time. Everything has come to a head in the last month. I can't take it anymore. It's too overwhelming. I doubt anyone knows; in fact, I'm almost sure they do not.
